description: Full original031 over every original algebraically closed characteristic-zero field and even L >= 3. For every actual component, canonical compact Hodge extension, natural n (including zero), actual normal frame cover and nonzero global section with its actual section divisor, the residue-weighted degree satisfies exactly 24*degree=n*2*L*#cusps and the upper bound n*#SL2. Canonical retains every actual disk test, the specific Tate cubic, normalized differential and actual canonical pointed differential pullback, with a unique extending generator. No arbitrary line, scalar comparison, degree or expansion function replaces these objects. The complete types and available bodies of these constructions are retained.
